resources.string: Model setup is optional. Today tasks and Settings work without it. Selecting a provider saves your choice; it does not download anything or delete tasks or Qwen weights. Use Back to return at any time.
Model installed. Open Lab to initialize local inference.
The local engine could not initialize. Retry initialization or open model setup.
Generation failed. You can retry your prompt.
Inference is unavailable until the selected provider is ready.
Model ready. Tap Thwip Test to run inference on this device.
Today tasks and Settings remain available.
Thwiply couldn\'t remove expired notification data. Expired items stay hidden and your tasks are unaffected.
LiteRT-LM • separate 1.49 GiB download, pinned and verified by Thwiply. Stored privately by this app. Interrupted downloads can resume when the server supports it.

ML Kit • Android AICore manages a shared model on supported devices. A download may be needed, and the model still uses storage and RAM. This avoids Thwiply’s separate Qwen download, not all downloads.

Gemini Nano works only while Thwiply is the top foreground app. Setup and Lab only; not background notification triage. Leaving stops this app’s operation. Android may continue managing a shared download.
Your provider choice could not be read or saved. No automatic fallback was selected. Choose a provider again to retry.
An operation is running or stopping. Wait for it to finish before starting another.
Gemini Nano availability needs a fresh check.
Gemini Nano is not available right now. The device may be unsupported or AICore may still need configuration or updates. You can check again; Thwiply will not switch providers automatically.
Gemini Nano needs preparation or a download managed by Android.
Android is downloading Gemini Nano. No percentage is available. Check again after the download finishes.
Qwen download is running or stopping. Wait before starting another operation.
Gemini Nano is available for foreground Lab use.

Android may download a shared model and use storage and RAM. The size depends on your device. Use an unmetered connection if needed. Thwiply cannot delete AICore’s shared model. This does not download Qwen.

Gemini Nano is for adults (18+) only under the ML Kit GenAI terms. Prompts and responses are processed on-device. ML Kit contacts Google for updates and configuration and sends usage and performance metrics, including identifiers and input/output sizes. This choice does not download a model.
I am 18 or older; select Nano
Stopped. Any partial output is incomplete.
Maximum 2,000 input characters. Nano also checks the complete prompt against its token limit.
Experimental output, including JSON: may be inaccurate, is not validated triage, and is not saved as tasks. Do not rely on it for medical, legal, financial, or other high-stakes decisions.
Characters count Unicode code points, not model tokens or streamed chunks.
The selected model is not ready. Open model setup or check availability.
AICore is not ready. Check Android system and AICore updates, then try checking availability again.
Android could not prepare the model. Check connectivity and storage, then retry explicitly.
The model is busy. Wait before trying again.
Android’s inference quota has been reached. Try again later.
This operation requires Thwiply to be the top foreground app. Bring Thwiply to the foreground and retry.
The model rejected this request for safety. No response is shown.
The prompt exceeds the supported input limit. Shorten it before trying again.
Enter a non-empty prompt with enough context for the model.
The model returned no text. Try a different short prompt.
The operation exceeded its time limit. Any partial output is incomplete. Retry only after it stops.
Output reached the Lab limit and was stopped. Any displayed output is incomplete.
The selected provider failed. You can retry or explicitly choose a different provider in setup.
Qwen model information could not be read. Retry in Lab or choose a different provider. No weights were removed.
Qwen files belong to Thwiply. Nano belongs to Android AICore and can be shared with other apps; Thwiply cannot remove that shared model. Changing providers leaves manual tasks and Qwen files intact.

Lab prompts and responses are processed on-device and are not saved as tasks. Qwen downloads come from Hugging Face. Android manages Nano downloads and updates. ML Kit contacts Google for updates and configuration and sends usage and performance metrics, including identifiers and input/output sizes; it does not send Lab prompts or responses to Google. The included SDK can initialize before provider selection. Nano use is for adults (18+) only. This alpha does not capture notifications or screenshots.
Run the local inference Lab on your device. Notification triage is not enabled in this alpha.
